notes: M2 boundary review blocker #3a: flips the pre-repair behavior. A manifest entry naming a generator id this binary does not recognize used to report the benign 'not adopted' state (zero findings, checked excluded, exit 0) — a typo'd or unregistered generator therefore green-lit an entirely unchecked artifact at checked 0/1. Now a BLOCKING manifest ERROR: this binary cannot verify the declared artifact, and a manifest declaring an unverifiable artifact must never exit green. argument/INDEX.md is not even required to exist on disk for this ERROR to fire — the unrecognized-generator check never reaches the have/want comparison. Mutation-proven red-first (temporarily reverting the unrecognized-generator branch to the old 'notAdopted, no finding' behavior turns this fixture green when it must be red; reverted after confirming).
